commentary.text: 90+9' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+9' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+9' Jose Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+6' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Real Sociedad win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

90+2' 3 - 2 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal slips a clever pass through to Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the top right corner. 3:2.
90+2' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
89' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
86' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' That's the end of the game for Andoni Gorosabel, who is replaced by Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao).
82' Sergio Francisco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mikel Goti Lopez (Real Sociedad) replacing Carlos Soler.
82' Arsen Zakharyan is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
82' Jose Munuera sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
81' Wait! Referee Jose Munuera has indicated he is going to review the Ath Bilbao goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
79' 2 - 2 Goal! Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
77' The expression of the referee Jose Munuera is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) is shown a yellow card.
76' A crossfield pass from Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
75' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
73' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad). Now Real Sociedad have a corner.

71' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
68' Here's the change. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta leaves the pitch and Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) comes on as a substitute.
67' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
65' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) picks up a caution.
65' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) brings his opponent down. Jose Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad will take a free kick near the side line.

64' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
63' Sergio Francisco has decided to substitute Goncalo Guedes and he is replaced by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
63' The substitution has been made. Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) has replaced Brais Mendez.
60' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
59' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
58' The attendance for today's match is 37685.
57' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
53' Substitution. Oihan Sancet is replaced by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao).
53' Jose Munuera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad).
51' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
47' 2 - 1 Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+8' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
45+7' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
45+3' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+3' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
42' 1 - 1 After the keeper softly punches the ball away, it lands at the feet of Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) who knows what to do with it and sends it inside the right-hand post.
41' Sergio Francisco is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) suffers an injury and Arsen Zakharyan comes on.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
37' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' The game is interrupted now, Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
33' The game is interrupted as Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is flagged offside.
33' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
30' A raking crossfield pass from Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
27' Jose Munuera blows the whistle, Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick.

26' Golden chance! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
24' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
20' The corner from Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by the defence.
19' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.
16' Ath Bilbao are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
13' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
11' The Real Sociedad players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for holding. Jose Munuera signals a set piece. Free kick. Real Sociedad will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
6' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
2' Referee Jose Munuera sees the trip by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Ath Bilbao have a free kick.
1' A lofted cross from Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Ath Bilbao will kick the game off.
Jose Munuera will officiate today.
